title: Unit Event — Stick to Your Faith — Episode3 Until I'm Satisfied

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need are gearing up to make their professional debut. As their label considers how best to market the band, Mr. Shindo asks the girls what music they aspire to.

rows.Line: Several years earlier
Elementary School - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, everyone. Please choose whichever characters you like from this list of examples.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Some of these kanji may be a little difficult since you haven't learned them yet, but please don't be afraid of a challenge...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Those kanji do look hard...
But I think I'll give them a try.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I wanna make sure I draw something I'm happy with.)
se_event_stickto_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(And stop here...
Flick here and...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Oh no...!
The ink got a little smeared at the end...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (One more time... From the beginning...!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori, I see you chose the character for “resonate”.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You take calligraphy lessons outside of school, yes? You're quite talented.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I'm really not...
I need to redo this one again.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Redo?! But...
I think it looks wonderful...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I'm having trouble getting the flick at the end to look nice, and it's unbalanced too.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
Hehe. Your work ethic is admirable, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Then, please keep trying your best.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I will...
se_event_stickto_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, let's stop there for today.
Please come place your work on this table over here.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, we're done with class.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I drew so many, but none seem all that...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Excuse me, I have a question.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, how can I help?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I got a little more time to work on my calligraphy assignment?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I'm still not happy with what I have...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I suppose I could give you a little more time...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Then, please...!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay. Then, I'll give you until Friday to finish the character you were working on...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I'll let the others know that they'll also have until Friday.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!
A few days later
Recess
se_event_stickto_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm supposed to turn in my calligraphy today...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (But I'm still not happy with what I drew. That means I'm gonna have to stay after school to...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, wait... Today's...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hey, remember what's happening today?
You promised you would!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember.
Your birthday party, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I mean, I still can't believe you invited basically all the girls in class.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, what's the problem? My mom said I could have as many friends over as I wanted!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Um, can we talk for a second?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: About that party you were just talking about...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: There's something I need to do today, so I'm not gonna be able to make it. I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?
What is it you need to do?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I promised the teacher that I'd turn in my calligraphy assignment today, but I'm still not happy with what I have. I need to get it right.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry for breaking our promise.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, no...! Don't worry about that!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks...
I hope you have a fun birthday party.
After school

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Stop here and... Flick...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Okay, that looks good...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(But it's sorta off to the left a bit.
I need to balance out the negative space better for my next one. Just be careful how big your brush strokes are and...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (They're supposed to be in the teachers' office until five. I have to finish before then.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A's Voice
rows.Line: This birthday party's gonna be so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Oh, they're all still here.
I guess they're in the corridor...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate C's Voice
rows.Line:
How many people are coming today?
You invited basically every girl in our class, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A's Voice
rows.Line:
Um, I wanna say fifteen.
Oh, but Shiho said she can't make it because of that calligraphy assignment.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C's Voice
rows.Line:
Wait, she's still working on it?
I just drew whatever and handed that in.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B's Voice
rows.Line: I mean, she does take lessons outside of school. I kinda get why she's trying so hard.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C's Voice
rows.Line:
Right...
But she promised ages ago that she'd come. Shouldn't this party take priority?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But if it didn't sound like she was gonna budge...

rows.Speaker: Classmate C's Voice
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at the time!
Everyone else is waiting by the school gate, right? Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah, let's hurry!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I need to finish this...
